review_candidates.description: If you also believe that everyone should be able to achieve their financial potential, then you’ll love contributing to CMC Markets’ company vision of providing the ultimate trading experience. Seize the opportunity to progress your career in the fintech industry by joining a global leader in CFD trading and share investing. Grow yourself personally and professionally with a company that’s growing with you, by global expansion and product offering. As a Senior Site Reliability Engineer at CMC Markets, you will work on platforms that support millions of trading decisions. .You will play a key role in improving reliability, availability, and performance across our trading platform, large scale systems, ensuring customers can access markets when it matters most. Your work will be highly visible and meaningful, giving you a strong sense of contribution and influence in what you deliver. This is a hands on opportunity for someone who enjoys building capabilities from the ground up. You'll work closely with engineers and technology stakeholders to establish and embed practical Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) practices, including SLOs/SLIs, incident management, post-incident reviews, runbooks, automation, and continuous improvement. As an integral part of the development lifecycle, you'll help design and deliver resilient, scalable, secure, high performing, and observable digital products and platforms for trading. Working within a collaborative Agile environment, you'll take ownership of service reliability by defining and measuring SLOs, while driving meaningful improvements in system availability, performance, and key operational metrics. This is an exciting opportunity for someone who thrives on solving complex problems, enjoys challenging the status quo, and is passionate about bringing innovative ideas that improve the way technology is built and operated. Why You'll like working here Just some of the reasons you’ll love working here include: Leave benefits: Enjoy your birthday off to spend time with family and friends, on us! Utilise a free annual charity day to give back to your community. $0 Trades: Staff & family trading accounts with CMC Markets Invest have access to the best brokerage rates in the market - $0 trades for all domestic and international equity orders! Continuous learning: Our L&D offering covers both technical and performance training, ensuring you're always learning new skills. Unlimited access to a dedicated benefits & wellbeing hub where you can save money through various retailer discounts, and make use of a variety of resources that will enhance your physical and mental wellbeing. Collaboration: We believe that great things happen when smart people work together, that’s why we’ve made the decision to work five days in the office. Office perks: Help yourself to free breakfast cereals, condiments, and coffee to fuel your workday. Our culture club provides opportunities for everyone whether you’re into fitness, pizza making classes, socialising or bringing out your competitive side in trivia or lawn bowls! What you’ll be working on Establish, maintain, and report on SLIs, SLOs, and error budgets to improve service reliability. Improve observability standards, patterns, and best practices through metrics, logs, distributed tracing, dashboards, alerting, and actionable signals, including leading OpenTelemetry adoption. Lead incident response, triage, stakeholder communications, blameless post incident reviews, and root cause analysis. Reduce operational toil through automation, self service capabilities, safe deployments, automated recovery, and reusable tooling. Partner with engineering teams to improve reliability focused architecture, release safety, operational readiness, and change risk management. Improve performance, scalability, resilience, and capacity management across production services. Build and maintain runbooks, playbooks, operational documentation, dashboards, templates, and internal services. Improve the reliability, availability, and performance of large scale .NET and TypeScript applications. Design and manage Infrastructure as Code using Terraform and related tooling. Troubleshoot complex production issues across application, infrastructure, and network layers. Act as the SME for reliability, observability, performance, and operational excellence. Participate in on call rotation, if and when required. Maintain personal/professional development to meet the changing demands of the role, including all relevant regulatory and legislative training What will help you be successful?
